value.rationale: The sign of simultaneous neighboring spectral-gap correlation diagnoses repulsion versus common-clock scaling in a physically motivated reset random-matrix model. The theorem gives an exact sharp universal positive floor, identifies the minimizing deterministic protocol, and exposes an opposite-sign fixed-age baseline. It is neither a mere marginal table nor an arbitrary unmotivated parameter slice; the three-level choice is the first size with two consecutive gaps.
